title: Sector Selector daily ranking snapshot
description: Append-only Friday-close (or later daily) board. NEVER overwrite a prior YYYY-MM-DD.json. V1 Sector Score is the public formula. Rotation Score is reserved — do not invent values.

modelVersion.description: Scoring model id. v1-sector-score is the public clip/round formula.

rotationScore.description: Architecture only. status must stay COMING SOON until a validated model ships. Never copy rs13w into this field.

rs13w.description: 13-week excess vs SPY, percentage points, price-only.

vs50d.description: Percent distance to 50-day SMA. null + vs50dMissing means location term = 0.

vs200d.description: Percent distance to 200-day SMA. Architected for later; not in the V1 formula.

rotationScore.description: Must be null while Rotation Score is COMING SOON.

change.description: Rank delta vs a prior snapshot. null on the first stored day — never invent arrows.

trend.description: Improving | Stable | Deteriorating. Only when two dates exist.

hold.description: Confirmed hold — not a new ticket.
